n: NOAA Ocean Explorer Underwater Robots lessons
t: NOAA lessons on how ROVs and AUVs gather data from the ocean.
steps: Find the Underwater Robots lessons on the NOAA Ocean Exploration site.
Download the lesson PDFs you want.
Check that each link works because some may be stale.
Review the lesson for your grade level.
Gather any materials the lesson lists.
Look at the Smithsonian Ocean Portal lesson I, Robot, Can Do That as a companion.
